specification: Eduqas C700QS, current local specification v3 January 2019; preparation for 2027
coverage: Component 1 Section B: AO5 communication, narrative development, organisation and coherence
AO6 vocabulary, sentence control, spelling and punctuation
Exact prompt fulfilment, narrative/recount, viewpoint, setting, character, dialogue and meaningful endings
assessment: Creative prose is one 40-mark narrative/recount chosen from four prompts, with AO5 24/AO6 16. Official sample papers suggest approximately 450–600 words. Short skill questions use original practice allocations; the two complete stories are original illustrative models, not official marked scripts.
